departures: The Docker daemon was not running in the container, so it was started with dockerd before any Docker step; machine.txt keeps the output from before and after.
The first run's image build failed because containers do not trust the agent proxy's TLS certificate; its logs are kept with the suffix -run1.
The first run's sandbox steps needed a manual chown, and its moka doctests all failed because sb mounted /tmp noexec; those logs are kept with the suffix -run1.
Every step that uses the image or sb was rerun with the sandbox from branch claude/sandbox-cloud-fixes (commit c654508, which differs from 65dbe29 only in a comment), not from main at 691e96b.
That sandbox installs the proxy CA certificate into the image, so the image differs from earlier rounds' image by that certificate.
This session's own token usage is not available from inside the session, so usage is null; the only measured child cost is child_limits at 0.00137 USD, and the two claude_cli calls reported none.
child_limits used claude-haiku-5-5, as claude_cli did, since the issue sets no model for that probe.
